passages.text: The Bluewing desk adjusts from 65 cm to 125 cm and stores up to four height presets.
Ming Wang approved a dual-motor design so the desk can carry up to 120 kg.
David Chou is designing the control panel, which uses a single knob instead of buttons.
Project Bluewing is led by Ming Wang, manager of Product Development, with David Chou and Zhiming Lin on the team.
The Bluewing desk is planned to launch in the second quarter of 2026.
